purpose: Boilerplate for building microservices with NestJS and spec-driven development (SDD): capabilities are described as requirements before they are implemented.

arch.web: React client with Vite, TanStack Router/Query and i18next
arch.api: NestJS host that integrates the services
arch.runtimeText: apps/api hosts the auth, users and orders modules; in this boilerplate they are not deployed as independent services.
